name: 5 mm LED, red
description: Indicator LED. Always needs a series resistor.
notes: Red: forward voltage about 1.8-2.2 V (2.0 V typical) at 20 mA, 30 mA absolute max. Other colours (blue, white, green) are about 3.0-3.4 V.
Resistor: R = (Vsupply - Vf) / I. From 5 V at 10 mA: 300 Ohm -> use 330 Ohm. From 3.3 V at 5 mA: 260 Ohm -> use 270 Ohm.
Long leg = anode (+). The flat edge on the rim marks the cathode.

geometry.note: T-1 3/4 package, 5 mm dome, 2.54 mm lead spacing; panel hole 5 mm (bezel 6 mm).
